Group threads you were never meant to see. A number you shouldn't have saved. Messages at 2am that you get to answer — and every answer changes who trusts you, who wants you, and how your story ends. ON THE SHELF NOW • Omerta — Mafia romance. One year as personal fixer to New York's youngest don clears your family's debt. Falling for him breaks every rule. So does telling him what you really are. • Moonbound — Werewolf romance. He rejected you in front of the whole pack at nineteen. Six years later your grandmother's death calls you home, and the bond that was supposed to be broken has other ideas. • Thornwilde — Fae romance. Your brother walked into a night market at nine years old and never walked out. Seven years later a number with no area code says he is alive, and offers to take you to him. More stories join the library over time, and your gems carry across all of them. EVERY CHOICE IS LOAD-BEARING These aren't cosmetic dialogue options. apps.description: ONE SWIPE. EVERYTHING. SEVER is a one-finger action roguelite where a single swipe is your attack, your dash and your dodge — all at once. Draw a line, commit to the cut, and vanish through your enemies before they close in. No virtual joysticks. No button mashing. Just you, one blade, and total commitment to every strike. COMMITTED MELEE COMBAT Every swipe is a dash-slash: you carve through everything on the line and slip through attacks in the same motion. Chain kills to keep momentum — hesitate and the arena punishes you. 15 UNIQUE BLADES From the lightning-fast Dagger to the massive Nodachi, every weapon retunes your dash — reach, speed, arc and risk. Unlock new blades by descending deeper, then master the edge that fits your style. FELL THE WARDENS A boss guards every floor. Read the telegraph, dash through the sweep, punish the recovery. Deeper down, they hunt in packs. BUILD SOMETHING UNFAIR After every boss, sharpen your blade: hone your stats, learn deadly arts, weave wards — or gamble on a blood pact. apps.name: Steppin Stones
apps.description: A deceptively hard puzzle that will have you thinking three moves ahead. Can you find the perfect path? In Steppin’ Stones, every move matters. Slide, plan, and connect your way across beautifully minimal levels where each stone can only move a limited number of spaces. Your goal? Reach the other side one thoughtful step at a time. How it works: - Tap a stone to choose it. - Pick a direction and move within its limit. - Strategically connect stones to create a full path to the goal. It sounds simple... until it isn’t. With each of the 18 handcrafted levels, new challenges will test your logic, timing, and foresight. Features: - 18 thoughtfully designed puzzles to relax and challenge your mind - 3 daily challenges ranging from easy, medium to hard (and they can get really hard) - Clean, minimal design — no distractions, just pure strategy - No timers, no pressure — just you and your next move Easy to learn. Hard to master. Incredibly satisfying. apps.name: Unlike
apps.description: Every number counts the neighbours unlike it. That is the entire rule. Each square is either solid or outlined, and a numbered square tells you how many of the four squares touching it — above, below, left and right — are the opposite of itself. Everything else follows from reasoning. NEVER A GUESS Every board is generated and then checked before you ever see it: exactly one solution, and that solution reachable by deduction alone. Beginner, Intermediate and Hard boards need nothing but direct logic — never "suppose this square is solid and see what breaks". Expert and Impossible boards permit that step at most once. Anything harder is thrown away and regenerated. If you are stuck, there is a move to find. THE SAME BOARD FOR EVERYONE Level 17 is the same grid on every device, and the same again after a reinstall. Compare times with a friend and you know you solved an identical puzzle. HINTS THAT EXPLAIN RATHER THAN SPOIL The first hint points at the clue that is ready to be used. The second spells out the deduction behind it. Only the third fills the square in for you. Stop at whichever tier you like. apps.name: VOLTFIELD: 80s Classic Arcade
apps.description: VOLTFIELD is a neon arcade game about taking ground back, made in the spirit of the old classics Qix and Volfied. You fly a small ship along the edge of a grid. Swipe to turn. The ship never stops. Leave the safe edge and you draw a live wire behind you. Close the loop, and everything you cut off is yours. Enemies hunt your wire. One touch and the run is over. Claim enough and the exit gate opens. Leave, or keep carving for more stars. The enemies get angrier the deeper you cut. THE GRID • 100 handmade levels across 10 sectors • Burning walls, moving fire bars, rotors, arc gates, and currents that push your ship • 10 boss fights against the Wardens, each in its own arena • Boosters: homing bolt, pulse bomb, mines, ghost wire, breaker, overdrive DAILY VOLT • One new field every day, the same for every player • 3 attempts. Carve as much as you can, every percent counts • Share your result and challenge friends on Game Center leaderboards All graphics, sound and music are generated by code. No ads. apps.name: Zanshin Spirit: Leaf Blade
apps.description: Zanshin Spirit: Leaf Blade is a one-swipe slashing action game wrapped in modern Japanese aesthetics — lacquer black, gold leaf, and crimson. Leaves fall from above. Slash them inside the striking window at the bottom of the screen. The sharper your timing, the higher the grade: Issen (perfect), Good, Take, or Shallow. Chain cuts to raise your combo multiplier through kanji tiers — up to x10. Miss three leaves and it's over. One run lasts 30 seconds to 3 minutes. FEATURES - One-finger control: just swipe to slash. No tutorial needed. - Precision grading: the closer to the perfect moment, the bigger the score. - Combo multipliers with kanji tier calls, up to x10. - Multi-cut bonus: slice several leaves in a single stroke for extra points. - Charge slash: hold to charge, then cut everything on screen in one flash. - Three modes: Zanshin (survival), Ichigeki (60-second score attack), Shingan (silhouette challenge). - Global ranking: submit your best score with a nickname of your choice. - Rare golden leaves worth 5x points. - 9 languages: English, Japanese, Simplified/Traditional Chinese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese. Free to play, with an optional "Remove Ads" support
